_README: The agent registry, read by /usr/libexec/almanac-agentbox on the host and
shipped unchanged into the guest image so the two cannot disagree.
command    the executable to run inside the microVM
package    the npm package that provides it
token_vars environment variables forwarded into the guest BY NAME if
they are set on the host. Never NAME=value: the value would
land in the wrapper's argv and from there in ps output.
built      whether agent_image/Containerfile actually installs it.
This mirrors the WITH_<AGENT> build arg defaults and has to
be changed in the same commit that changes them.
